meta.name: strategic-alliances
meta.description: Structures partnerships that change what the business can do — technology integrations, channel and reseller arrangements, joint ventures, and OEM relationships. Use this to evaluate or structure a strategic partnership, decide between partnering and building, negotiate commercial terms of an alliance, or diagnose a partnership that is signed but not producing. For audience-borrowing partnerships, use `marketing:partnership-marketing`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把合作机会谈成能改变业务的战略联盟
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责商业合作,需要评估或设计战略联盟
copy.tagline_en: Structure partnerships that change what your business can do
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle business partnerships and need to evaluate or shape alliances

howto.what: Claude 会采用战略联盟框架，指导你评估和构建战略伙伴关系：判断合作/自建/购买、梳理双方真实动机、设计排他性和收益分成等关键条款，并建议如何落地和诊断停滞合作。
howto.when: 当你说要评估或构建战略伙伴关系、决定合作还是自建，或诊断已签约但没产出的合作时触发。

say.text: 帮我评估和这家公司建立技术集成合作是否可行。
say.note: Claude 会按合作/自建/购买框架分析。

say.text: 我们签了合作协议但没产出，帮我诊断哪里出了问题。
say.note: Claude 会检查负责人、激励、依赖等常见原因。

say.text: 谈判前帮我列出联盟协议应包含的关键条款。
say.note: Claude 会给出排他性、经济、数据等条款清单。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the strategic-alliance approach to evaluate or structure partnerships: decide partner/build/buy, clarify motivations, design terms (exclusivity, economics), and advise on execution and diagnosing stalled deals.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to evaluate or structure a strategic partnership, decide between partnering and building, or diagnose a signed partnership that is not producing.

say_en.text: Help me evaluate whether a tech-integration partnership with this company makes sense.
We signed a partnership but it's not producing. Help me diagnose why.
say_en.note: Claude checks ownership, incentives, and dependencies.

say_en.text: Before negotiating, list the key clauses our alliance agreement should cover.
say_en.note: Claude lists exclusivity, economics, data, etc.
